Bundled Mbed TLS v3.6.7 from https://github.com/Mbed-TLS/mbedtls/tree/v3.6.7
(upstream commit 068ff080b369adfac81509f9b57b2afabaf82dc5).
The include/, library/ and 3rdparty/ directories are upstream files; seven C files have only extra blank lines at EOF removed.
Used to make the Android authorization request without requiring Termux/curl.
